name: Regenerate draws a card into memory
notes: Regenerate's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 2-reserve cost is paid, then the unconditional draw effect resolves immediately with no opportunity-window PASS needed. The [Class Bonus][Damage 10+] Recover 2 clause is out of scope since the default SPIRIT-class champion doesn't match CLERIC/WARRIOR and hasn't taken 10+ damage.

rulesClauses: Draw a card into your memory.
